label: SYNTHETIC demo context (fictional people and messages): M1 book → writing ambition, V3 coffee → gift matched to taste

sources.original_text: War and Peace inspired me to try writing a novel, but I haven't started. The first chapter is still just in my head.
Random, but if you ever want to get me something: I like light-roast whole beans for pour-over. Dark roasts aren't my thing.
I tried War and Peace last summer and gave up after 50 pages. Way too long for me.
I quit coffee last month. Tea only now.
My sister keeps saying she wants to read War and Peace before she turns 30.
You have to read Anna Karenina. Best book I've ever read.
I'm into classic novels in general, always looking for recommendations.
